binding_rule: absolute Spearman > 0.90 OR > 70% of candidate dots within 3 px of one registry raster; literal rule, no matched-budget or dense-surface exemption

local.scope: all exact-grid single-band TIFFs in docs/downloads/, releases/, and data/parent_R0*.tif in this checkout

public.scope: Current public default branches; TIFF paths under docs/downloads/, releases/, and submission directories; unique Git blobs. Does not cover history, private repositories, other owners, zip-only objects, or site-hosted objects not in those paths.

overlap_interpretation.preplacement_surface_overlap: not a final-dot comparison: the audit helper counts every positive surface pixel as support; its raw 1.0 worst-overlap does not apply the user’s dot-only overlap test to a final dot field

audit_cli_note.candidate_argument: data/parent_R0_zeros.tif (CLI requires a candidate for its final phase)
audit_cli_note.phasewind_evidence_field: only audit output preplacement_surface refers to PHASEWIND
audit_cli_note.not_phasewind_evidence: audit output final summary is the parent R0 candidate and is excluded from all PHASEWIND conclusions

binding_witness.implication: Every nonempty candidate dot set in the allowed domain has forward overlap 1.0 with this prior; therefore it cannot pass the 0.70 gate.

sequence_scope: Surface registry correlation was checked after fold-specific holdout emissions used for DTI, but before any full-domain deployment placement. If 'placement' includes temporary holdout predictions, the scan was not strictly pre-placement; no final dots were created.
